title: claims.json — machine-checkable claims table for figure-audit-loop

note.description: Free-form provenance note, e.g. 'synthetic example' or the paper/materials this table was extracted from.

title.description: Figure title rendered on the canvas.

id.description: Stable identifier used in SVG ids as entity:<id>.

label.description: Visible label; genes are rendered italic, proteins upright.

source.description: Source locator: paper figure/table/sentence or data file + row, e.g. 'paper p.7 Fig.3B' or 'data.csv:row12'.

encodings.description: Data values driving visual encodings, keyed by field name, e.g. {"log2FC": 1.8}.

id.description: Used in SVG ids as edge:<id>.

from.description: Entity id at the regulatory SOURCE of the interaction.

to.description: Entity id at the TARGET (arrowhead / T-bar end).

evidence.description: If the materials do not establish direction or effect, use 'uncertain' — never invent certainty. Rendered dashed.

source.description: Source locator for this interaction claim.

field.description: Key in entities[].encodings this channel maps.

source.description: Data locator, e.g. 'results.csv column log2FC'. Numbers must be traceable.

item.description: Legend item id; appears as legend-swatch:<item> in the SVG.

color.description: Optional explicit swatch color '#rrggbb'. If omitted, colors for '<field>_low|_mid|_high' derive from the fill encoding scale.

expected_labels.description: Key labels that MUST appear as text in the rendered figure (used by SVG-text check and optional OCR check).

element.description: SVG element id to sample, e.g. 'legend-swatch:log2FC_low' or 'entity:RTK'.

region.description: Optional [x0,y0,x1,y1] as fractions of the canvas; overrides bbox lookup from the SVG.

edit_expectations.description: Case kind (3) only: what the source-preserving edit must change and what it must NOT touch.

changed_elements.description: SVG element ids that MUST differ between before.svg and after.svg.

unchanged_sample.description: SVG element ids that MUST remain byte-identical.
